analysis.estimated: Part of the result relies on model assumptions; this range is not a market forecast.
analysis.observed: Observed history is one input to the model; the result is still a simulated scenario.
analysis.nominalLossProbability: Probability of nominal loss against total contributions
analysis.aboveInflation: Above inflation in the median scenario
analysis.nearPreservation: Near preservation of purchasing power in the median scenario
analysis.belowInflation: Below inflation in the median scenario
analysis.p10Meaning: Only 10% of simulated paths ended at a lower value.
analysis.p50Meaning: Median path; half ended lower and half higher.
analysis.p90Meaning: Only 10% of simulated paths ended at a higher value.
analysis.centralScenario: Final value under the central return assumption, without random volatility
analysis.priorCorrelation: Blend of historical and assumed correlation
analysis.assumedCorrelation: Assumed correlation due to limited history
analysis.fixedRateScenario: Fixed-income scenario without net asset value history
analysis.simulationNotForecast: This range comes from simulated paths under the selected assumptions; it is not a forecast.
analysis.dataFetchFailed: History retrieval did not complete; only available fallback history is shown.
analysis.zeroDownside: Downside deviation is zero or negligible; the Sortino ratio is not reported.
analysis.insufficientDownside: Sortino requires at least five monthly observations below the minimum acceptable return.
analysis.insufficientSortino: Sortino requires at least 24 monthly returns.
analysis.unavailableBenchmark: The selected benchmark rate is missing from the data; Sortino cannot be calculated.
analysis.sortinoDefinition: Returns are monthly. Only returns below MAR count as downside; returns equal to MAR (including zero when MAR is zero) do not. The numerator is mean monthly excess return × 12; the denominator is the root mean square of shortfalls, with zero for months without shortfall, × √12. At least 24 months and five below-MAR observations are required; otherwise the ratio is not reported.
analysis.tailRiskUnavailable: Insufficient data to estimate the loss tail at 95% confidence.
analysis.tailRiskModelBased: Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall come from simulated monthly returns; they are neither guarantees nor empirical measurements.
analysis.feeUnknown: Fee unknown; assumed zero in the calculation
analysis.lazy: Open analysis to run the scenarios.
analysis.openForRange: The range is calculated when analysis opens.
analysis.failed: Calculation did not complete; try again.
analysis.modelGaussian: Gaussian Monte Carlo with return and correlation assumptions
analysis.modelEwma: Monte Carlo with greater weight on recent data
analysis.validationInsufficient: Insufficient data to validate the advanced method
analysis.modelledSleeveScope: The simulation currently models fixed income, gold, foreign currency, and silver only. Other assets are shown separately and their returns are not attributed to these categories.

backtest.insufficient: A backtest needs several months of history; not enough data was returned.
backtest.partial: The backtest reports only continuous observed periods; missing history is not filled with model assumptions.
backtest.full: This test used the available observed return series.
